DSCH-38: was Qto_BeamBaseQuantities.Weight, which IFC does not define. Qto_BeamBaseQuantities has GrossWeight (ignores cut-outs) and NetWeight (takes cut-outs, openings and recesses into account); a weight taken from the modelled, cut element is the net one (https://github.com/buildingSMART/IFC4.3.x-development/blob/master/reference_schemas/psd/Qto_BeamBaseQuantities.xml). element_types added so a weight from anything other than a beam is not exported into this set.

DSCH-38: was Qto_ColumnBaseQuantities.Weight, which IFC does not define. Qto_ColumnBaseQuantities has GrossWeight (ignores cut-outs) and NetWeight (takes cut-outs, openings and recesses into account); a weight taken from the modelled, cut element is the net one (https://github.com/buildingSMART/IFC4.3.x-development/blob/master/reference_schemas/psd/Qto_ColumnBaseQuantities.xml). element_types added so a weight from anything other than a column is not exported into this set.

DSCH-38: was Pset_WindowCommon.SolarHeatGainCoefficientGlazing, which IFC does not define. Pset_DoorWindowGlazingType.SolarHeatGainTransmittance is the SHGC / g-value, a 0-1 ratio (IFC4 and IFC4X3; https://github.com/buildingSMART/IFC4.3.x-development/blob/master/reference_schemas/psd/Pset_DoorWindowGlazingType.xml).

DSCH-38: was Pset_SpaceCommon.CeilingHeight, which IFC does not define. The clear ceiling height is Qto_SpaceBaseQuantities.FinishCeilingHeight, top of flooring to underside of the suspended ceiling (IFC4 and IFC4X3; https://github.com/buildingSMART/IFC4.3.x-development/blob/master/reference_schemas/psd/Qto_SpaceBaseQuantities.xml).
